parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique for each request. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot be longer than 64 characters.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the service instance.

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the service instance.

Call the [ListServiceInstances](~~396200~~) operation to obtain the service instance ID.
